attributes.board_name: Washington State Examining Board of Psychology (Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses, seminars, workshops and postdoctoral institutes offered by regionally accredited graduate-level institutions, APA, regional or state psychological associations, psychology internship training centers, other recognized behavioral science organizations, or the WA Examining Board of Psychology; the board does not preapprove courses
rules.new_licensee_rule: Must take and pass the jurisprudence examination within the first CE cycle after initial licensure.
rules.audit_note: Board may require documentation of the 60 hours (transcripts or certificates showing name, title, hours, dates, faculty, sponsor signature).

topics.who: All psychologists, every six years; course on DOH model list (first: assessment, treatment, management; later: advanced training)
Jurisprudence exam required in the first CE cycle; optional later (1 hour credit per cycle)

rules.notes: License renews every year on the birthday; CE is 60 hours per 3-year cycle. Teaching credit max 30 hours per 3 years. Renewal fee $295 plus $16 HEAL-WA fee.
rules.rule_quote: (1) To renew a license, a licensed psychologist shall complete at least 60 hours of continuing education (CE) every three years, including a minimum of: (a) Four hours in ethics.
